$comment: Scope map for a two-person team. Each scope names either 'team' (an id from penguin/teams.json), 'dri' (the team member who decides the scope's parts that need a person) and an optional 'fallback' (other team members, in order, who decide while the DRI has no bridge online and no session), or only 'owner', which reads as that person's one-person team with the owner as DRI. The other fields are as in examples/identity-unification/base/penguin/scopes.json.
